text:
Leah M.: Heads-up from the Datadog scoping call: they want a privacy-safe demo for the marketplace tile + HW SI metrics included. Can we list owners & quick plan here?
Omar (eng): I can take the engineer side for trace/metric payloads. primary asks: remove sensitive prompt text, add model metadata attrs, and provide a small sample dashboard JSON.
Rina P.: Legal requires prompt redaction to be provably non-reversible. They suggested HMAC + salt stored in customer KMS. Also need a blurb for the marketplace that calls out no PII or prompt content is retained.
Karthik (obs): From DD: sampling rules must be configurable; recommend default 1% with overrides for rw.model.stage=="staging" or latency > 1.5s -> 100%. They also want gpu labels like gpu.model and gpu.serial for SI correlation.
Omar (eng): Plan: tracer-side HMAC of prompt -> rw.prompt.id, no raw prompt exported. We'll add rw.model.name, rw.model.version, rw.instance for lineage. Also will emit metrics: redwood.gpu.util_pct, redwood.inference.lat_ms, redwood.batch.size.
Leah M.: Good. Sam from partnerships (out of thread) said DD also needs an embargo window and a sampling doc attached to the certification packet. Can we target end-of-week smoke test?
integrations-bot: Created RDW-5042: "DD marketplace - privacy-safe tile + HW metrics" assigned to Omar (eng) and Karthik (obs). Due: 2025-05-16.
Karthik (obs): I'll draft the dashboard panels DD asked for: overview (p50/p95 latency, active model counts), host GPU grid, and an incidents panel (top slow traces, error rate). Can export JSON once Omar publishes sample metrics.
Rina P.: For sign-off, legal needs: 1) HMAC algorithm & key rotation plan 2) where hashes are stored 3) statement: "no raw prompts or PII are exported to partners or third-party telemetry". I'll sketch language and post here.
Omar (eng): Requesting Datadog staging API key and a partner test org. Also will hand off a tiny OTEL collector config that maps nvml labels into resource.attributes.
Leah M.: I'll request staging creds from DD and schedule a 30m smoke slot Thu 11:00 PT. Keep the thread lean and attach artifacts to RDW-5042.
Omar (eng): will post the collector snippet and a short harness trace payload (cold vs warm) here once ready.
